description: Start a group order (a lunch or coffee run) at a shop, when the user wants to order together with others now. Returns a code to share: each person's agent joins with it and pays for their own items. When it closes, the shop gets one combined order and the organiser is emailed its pickup QR. To share agentPickup itself with a friend, use share_agentpickup instead.

organiser_email.description: Where the group's pickup QR goes

shop_url.description: An agentPickup shop's URL, as find_shops returns it. Defaults to https://agentpickup.app.

name: start_group_order
title: Start a group order
